assertions.name: taylor_extraction_does_not_yield_pr664_value
assertions.source: Direct Taylor extraction of σ_1² at q=1+ε to ε^6 in either tr_M implementation gives values (7/8 or -63/256) that do not match PR #664's c_3 = -2 claim.

description: Genuine c_3 extraction attempt via Taylor expansion of tr_M(σ_1²) at q=1+ε to ε^6. Ports PR #661's c_2 = b² methodology. NEGATIVE RESULT: neither of the two tr_M implementations on main yields ε^6 = -2 for σ_1²; PR #664's c_3 = -2 claim is not recoverable from this direct route. The probe documents that the c_3 categorical derivation requires either (a) a different categorical object (V_(2,2,2)-projected in H_6), (b) a writhe-corrected tr_M, or (c) a convention choice the PR didn't make.
caveats: This probe DOES NOT disprove c_3 = -2.  It shows the simplest interpretation of PR #664's claim ("c_3 is the ε^6 coefficient of σ_1²'s Markov trace") is FALSE.  The genuine derivation could still recover c_3 = -2 via the V_(2,2,2) channel in H_6 (per PR #664's hand-waved proof sketch Step 2) or via a writhe-correction step — both of which remain to be done.
